title: Attributing Security Outcomes in LLM-Agent Evaluations: The Role of Content-Free State
abstract: arXiv:2611.30259v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Security benchmarks for LLM agents record whether each attack succeeded and compare agents, attacks, and defenses by attack success rate (ASR). Such comparisons are valid only if the agent, the attack, and the defense cause each verdict. We show that verdicts also depend on content-free state: details of a run that carry no information about the system under test, such as the Python hash seed, the order of tools or evidence, and the scoring of failed runs. We require that this state influence no verdict (decision noninterference) and treat it as untrusted input, because evaluators and requesters of LLM-based gates can choose it. Our framework, TARE (Testing Attribution of Reported Effects), attributes a reported effect to the agent, attack, or defense only if it exceeds the measured influence of content-free state. translated_title: 在LLM智能体评估中归因安全结果：无内容状态的作用
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的安全基准测试记录每次攻击是否成功，并通过攻击成功率（ASR）来比较智能体、攻击和防御方法。只有当每个判定结果确实由智能体、攻击和防御所导致时，这种比较才是有效的。我们证明，判定结果还依赖于“无内容状态”：即运行过程中不携带任何关于被测系统信息的细节，例如Python哈希种子、工具或证据的顺序，以及对失败运行的评分方式。我们要求这种状态不影响任何判定结果（决策非干扰性），并将其视为不受信任的输入，因为评估者以及基于LLM的门控请求者可以选择它。我们的框架TARE（报告效应的测试归因，Testing Attribution of Reported Effects）只有在报告的效应超过所测量的无内容状态影响时，才将其归因于智能体、攻击或防御。在Agent Security Bench（ASB）上，使用固定哈希种子的运行对于来自四个模型家族的七个智能体是完全相同的，然而（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TARE框架，揭示LLM智能体安全评估的判定结果会受到与被测系统无关的“无内容状态”（如哈希种子、工具顺序等）的影响，并只有在效应超过这种状态的影响时才将其归因于智能体、攻击或防御。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TARE, a framework revealing that LLM-agent security evaluation verdicts depend on content-free state (e.g., hash seeds, tool ordering), and attributes reported effects to the agent, attack, or defense only when they exceed the measured influence of such state.
